instructions: Read-only MCP server for IELTS Writing Task 2 sample answers, Speaking Part 2 cue card topics and Writing band descriptors. No API key required.

tools.name: list_writing_samples
tools.description: List public IELTS Writing Task 2 sample answers with prompts, source papers, reference bands, word counts and previews.

tools.name: get_writing_sample
tools.description: Read one public IELTS Writing Task 2 model essay in full by sample ID.

tools.name: list_cue_cards
tools.description: List public IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card topics with prompts, points to cover and related Part 3 questions.

tools.name: get_band_descriptors
tools.description: Get the four IELTS Writing assessment criteria and plain-language Band 5 to Band 8 summaries.
